steps.title: Project Structure Initialization
steps.description: Initialize standard Android folder hierarchy and configuration files.

steps.title: Configure Security and Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with Internet permissions and declare target activities without AndroidX dependencies.

steps.title: Generate Assets Configuration
steps.description: Store application meta-data in assets folder for runtime dynamic reading of app_id.

steps.title: Design Resources and Color Palette
steps.description: Define lightweight Material design-compliant color resources and design strings.

steps.title: Implement API Client Core
steps.description: Create BackendApi.java using standard HttpURLConnection and Native Threads. Strictly implements endpoints /register, /login, /logout, /request-otp, /reset-password, and /data.

steps.title: Build Transaction Model Class
steps.description: Create Transaction.java to represent financial records with helper calculation properties.

steps.title: Design Login View Layout
steps.description: Draft standard UI layouts for User Authentication focusing on visual hierarchy.

steps.title: Implement Login Controller Activity
steps.description: Implement LoginActivity.java to handle credentials validation and authorization token storage.

steps.title: Design Registration View Layout
steps.description: Draft registration layout with email and password fields, using pure Android layouts.

steps.title: Implement Registration Controller Activity
steps.description: Implement RegisterActivity.java to validate and send data to /register, handling redirects sequentially.

steps.title: Design Forgot Password Layout
steps.description: Construct 2-step OTP request and password reset UI layout.

steps.title: Implement Forgot Password Controller
steps.description: Implement ResetPasswordActivity.java processing OTP delivery verification and password overrides.

steps.title: Design Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Design dynamic main layout containing header dashboard tiles, summary calculations, transaction list, and quick actions.

steps.title: Design Transaction Dialog View
steps.description: Construct a custom modal view layout for adding and updating ledger items locally.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard & Local Calculations Engine
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java with native calculations for income, expense totals, remaining balance, category percentages, and offline list handling.

steps.title: Building Smart Budget Tracker
steps.description: Execute final Gradle compilation and validation check of assets, manifests, layouts, and Java classes.
